meta.title: The Table Explodes... | 4 Player MTG Commander Gameplay Episode 2
meta.episode: 2 of 3 - continues game_log.json (Episode 1); concluded in Episode 3 ('The Victor is Chosen...', 1:26:45)
meta.extraction_method: YouTube auto-generated captions (ASR, no speaker labels). Confidence flags as in game_log.json.
meta.players_ref: See game_log.json: Alex (Tidus WUG counters), Jared (BRG Spacecraft lands-sac), Bolt (Cloud RGW equipment, new player), Weston (Clavileno WB vampires)

key_events.detail: ETB: attach up to one target Equipment you control to him - attaches the 7/7-setting equipment, Cloud becomes 7/7; can't be blocked by power <=2; whenever he attacks, draw a card per equipped attacking creature; if power 7+, create two Treasure tokens. Has haste ('everything has haste too')
Treasure tokens explained: artifact, sacrifice: add one mana of any color; usable right away (noncreature artifact, no summoning-sickness restriction on its mana ability)
Cloud (7/7) attacks Alex - 7 combat damage, and it IS commander damage (tracked; Alex notes at 7:03 he's taken 7 commander damage)
Paid using two Treasure tokens
Equip cost 8; +10/+10 and loses flying. Table math: Cloud with it = 17/17

Hexproof vs shroud: table says shroud means 'can't be targeted by anything' (correct) but describes hexproof as 'invulnerable to spells but you can still be targeted' - GARBLED. Correct: hexproof = can't be the target of spells/abilities OPPONENTS control; shroud = can't be the target of ANY spells/abilities including your own. Both are still hit by non-targeting board wipes (that part they got right)
Attacks Jared with 2/3 vampire; Clavileno trigger converts it to a Demon (death trigger rider); +1/+1 counter interaction discussed

key_events.card: Austere Command (heard as 'austerity command'; caster confirmed as Weston by 21:40 'when Weston played the board wipe')
key_events.detail: 6 mana sorcery, choose two: destroys all artifacts AND all creatures with mana value 3 or less. Kills most of the board including his own artifacts (Hammer of Purphoros) and Alex's board; Tidus goes back to command zone (owner's choice replacement)
key_events.validation: CORRECT - commander to command zone instead of graveyard is optional replacement

key_events.detail: Commander tax goes up 2 at a time - CORRECT (903.8). Alex marks it with a 'death counter' die on his commander

Tokens have mana value 0 (relevant to 'MV 3 or less' wipe) and Weston's Vampire Demon tokens created by the death triggers survive/arrive AFTER the wipe resolves - correct sequencing (death triggers go on stack after the sorcery finishes resolving)
Other Vampires get +1/+1

Tap: add one mana of any color; next creature spell this turn enters with two additional +1/+1 counters; when another permanent you control with counters dies, move that many +1/+1 counters to target creature
Sagas explained (lore counters tick each turn, chapter abilities)
ETB returns Myriad Landscape from graveyard to battlefield; whenever a land he controls is put into a graveyard, create a 5/3 green Elemental
Nothing to reveal, enters tapped

key_events.card: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero + has Jenova ('Genova') on board
key_events.detail: Jenova: whenever Sephiroth attacks, put a cell counter on target creature until end of turn; each modified creature you control has base P/T 7/5. Sephiroth: if he dies, return for 3 mana (as heard). 'Modified' = equipment/auras/counters
Hideaway 4: look at top 4, exile one face down; {W},{T}: play exiled card free if you attacked with 3+ creatures this turn
Paid 5 (3 + 2 commander tax)
Swings 15 flying (three 5/4-5/5 Vampire Demons) + 2 ground at Alex; Alex takes 15+

Fight Rigging: hideaway 5; at beginning of combat put +1/+1 counter on a creature; if you control a creature with power 7+, cast the hidden card free. Rikku enters with +2/+2 (Yuna's grant). At combat (30:10): counter placed; no power-7 creature, so no free cast
key_events.validation: CORRECT - condition checked and not met, free cast correctly declined

key_events.detail: Myriad Landscape: {2},{T}, sac: search two basic lands sharing a type (forests), enter tapped. Fabled Passage: sac, fetch basic; untaps itself with 4+ lands - wait, the fetched land enters untapped with 4+ lands (they say 'this one stays up')
4/4; whenever it attacks, attacker and defending player each discard a card or sacrifice a permanent; draw a card for each land put into graveyard this way
Once each turn, may cast an artifact spell from graveyard; casts Colossus Hammer from graveyard (enters tapped per Edgar's clause), still pays equip 8 separately - table handles this correctly

'Everything is a spell while being cast, except lands - lands are played, not cast.' CORRECT (and citing The Professor). Card on the stack can be countered; once resolved it's a permanent, not a spell

Tapped status has no bearing on equipping: you can equip/move equipment regardless of the artifact being tapped; entering tapped only prevents mana/tap abilities, not being equipped. Approximately correct

Sephiroth (7/5 via Jenova cell counter) + Cloud attack Alex. Good rules question at 41:44: does 'whenever Sephiroth attacks' trigger on declaration? Answer: YES, attack triggers fire on declare - CORRECT
Blocks Cloud with Rikku; takes 7 from Sephiroth (commander damage from Sephiroth? No - Sephiroth is not Bolt's commander; regular damage). Cell counter P/T effect ends at end of turn
Bolt forgot Cloud's attack triggers (draw per equipped attacker + two Treasures if power 7+); turn had passed. Table lets it go - missed-trigger handling (casual REL)
Choose Vampire: vampires +1/+1; {1}, sacrifice a vampire: target creature gains indestructible until end of turn
Three 6/5 flying Vampire Demons (18) attack Jared; 4 more at Alex incl. commander (commander damage noted at 48:27)
Instant response during combat: destroy target permanent (one attacker); its controller creates a 3/3 green Beast. Jared still takes 12 from remaining two attackers
key_events.validation: CORRECT - instant-speed removal after blockers/attackers declared

key_events.detail: Attacked with 3+ creatures: plays hidden card FREE - Timothar, Baron of Bats (ward: discard a card; when another nontoken vampire dies, pay 1, exile it, create 1/1 Bat with flying that returns the card when it deals combat damage)

key_events.card: Promise of Aclazotz (as heard 'Promise of Alazots')
key_events.detail: At beginning of your end step, may sacrifice a non-Demon creature; if you do, create a copy of a creature token you control. Sacrifices the Beast token, copies a Vampire Demon

THE TITLE MOMENT: chooses ALL modes - exile all artifacts, all creatures, all enchantments, all graveyards. Total board reset except lands. Asks 'anyone reacting to this?' (priority passing) before resolving
Commanders exiled by Farewell -> owners choose to put them into command zone as the exile replacement, 'right now'. CORRECT: 903.9a replacement applies as the commander would be exiled
'How big is your hand? It's public knowledge, you have to tell me.' CORRECT: number of cards in hand is free information
Search for Plains/Island/Swamp/Mountain, battlefield tapped
Filter land: {1},{T}: add two mana in combinations - color conversion explained correctly
3-mana artifact; sacrifice: draw a card
Post-Farewell rebuild begins; Jared far ahead on lands (13); game concludes in Episode 3

board_resets.card: Austere Command (choose two: all artifacts + all creatures MV<=3)
